Hi team,

Quick note for the shift ahead: keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk replies crisp, warm, and consistent. We should steer passengers through the usual companion animal steps without extra back-and-forth, and flag anything unclear right away so the next agent has a clean handoff. Use plain language, check the booking notes carefully, and keep the focus on helping the traveler move forward with confidence.

For cases involving small dog crate checks, <<FACT F068>> Make sure the rest of the guidance stays aligned with the standard process, and do not add side comments that could confuse the passenger. If a traveler sounds unsure, keep the tone steady and walk them through the required steps in order. We want the desk to feel organized and dependable, even when the queue is active.

Please also remember that every reply should leave the passenger with a clear next action and no loose ends. If a case needs a follow-up from the senior coordinator, note it cleanly and send it on without delay. Keep your own entries short, accurate, and easy for the next person to pick up. Thanks for staying sharp and keeping Aurelia Skyways moving.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
